title: Application of the Maestro Surgical System for Surgical Assistance in Laparoscopic Abdominal Surgery
official: Application of the Maestro Surgical System for Surgical Assistance in Laparoscopic Abdominal Surgery
summary: This study is designed to evaluate the application of the Maestro Robotic Platform for surgical assistance in laparoscopic abdominal surgery. The purpose of this study is to assess the system use in general surgery on different procedures, level of complexity, and type of setting (elective/emergency).

interventions.name: Any abdominal laparoscopic surgery with the usage of the Maestro Platform.

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

The participant must meet ALL the following criteria to be considered eligible for the study:

1. Aged 18 years or above
2. Undergoing minimally invasive abdominal surgery
3. Participant is able to give informed consent for participation in the study.

Exclusion Criteria:

The participant may not enter the study if ANY of the following apply:

1. Vulnerable populations
2. Any medical, psychiatric, or occupational condition, including a history of substance abuse, that may pose additional risk or interfere with study results, as determined by the investigator
